plan.narration_reading: Opened on the three crosses at dusk (09) for 'a psalm's last line and Jesus' last breath... it is done', then the bowed head (07) on 'it is done'. 'The psalm closes looking ahead' rides The Way Opened From The Dark (18) — Christ lit, dawn breaking; the scribe writing for a people not yet born (02) follows. 'That he hath done this' sits on the finished cross at dawn (15); the bridge to John runs over the pierced hands (10) and the face of Christ (16); 'It is finished' lands on the rending veil (08). The landing runs Looking Down In Love (19) on 'different words a thousand years apart' -> the burden set down (12) on 'what's left to finish' -> the open door home (13) -> 'come to Him' (17), and the hero crucifixion 'It Is Finished' (04) closes as a held still.
plan.red_team_notes: Dropped writing scenes 01/03/06 (garbled text) and the two weak clips 11 (open-book vignette + abstract glowing column) and 14 (abstract bright rectangle). Replaced with 18 (dawn-breaking crucifixion, fits 'looking ahead') and 19 (tender looking-down face, breaks the cross-heaviness on the resonance beat). 12 distinct clips, hero 04 not in the assignment, no reuse.
